ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the trend of Medicaid fraud and its impact on the healthcare system. It would explore the causes of the trend and potential solutions to prevent future cases of fraud.
questions: What are the causes of Medicaid fraud?
How can Medicaid fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale scheme or trend of Medicaid fraud, which could lead to significant reforms and changes in the healthcare system.

ideas.title: Federal Investigations: A Rise in Corruption

questions: What are the causes of federal investigations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale scheme or trend of corruption, which could lead to significant reforms and changes in the government and private sectors.
